calculation_handling.description: Transition rule: applications submitted on or before July 22, 2022 follow the earlier bicycle parking regulations.
Transition rule: applications submitted after July 22, 2022 and on or before March 31, 2025 follow the bicycle parking rates in 970.30.15.5(3) to (5).

970.30.1(1).explanation: Applications submitted on or before July 22, 2022 that qualify under the listed earlier clauses follow the bicycle parking rules as they read on that date, not the later rates.

970.30.1(2).explanation: Applications submitted after July 22, 2022 and on or before March 31, 2025 that qualify under the listed clauses follow the bicycle parking rates in 970.30.15.5(3) to (5).
